rules.description: Responses handling disputes or requests must include contact info (phone/email/WhatsApp)
Pricing responses must not promise unauthorized discounts or special deals
All responses must maintain a professional and helpful tone
No response should mention competitor platforms

must_contain_contact.description: Must contain a phone number, email, or contact directive
must_contain_contact.suggested_fix: Add contact information such as 'Please contact our staff via WhatsApp at +60127088789' or include an email address.

no_discount_promise.description: Must not promise discounts or special pricing without authorization
no_discount_promise.suggested_fix: Remove discount promises. Refer guests to the standard pricing page or ask them to contact management for special rate enquiries.

appropriate_tone.description: Must use professional and helpful language
appropriate_tone.suggested_fix: Replace dismissive language with helpful alternatives, e.g., 'Let me connect you with someone who can assist.'

no_competitor.description: Must not mention competitor booking platforms
no_competitor.suggested_fix: Remove competitor platform mentions. Direct guests to book directly or through approved channels only.
